name: Dōgen Zenji
shortBio: Founder of Soto Zen in Japan and one of East Asia's deepest philosophical minds, renowned for his radical phenomenological ontology of 'being-time' (Uji) and the non-duality of practice and realization (shusho itto).
centralQuestion: If all beings inherently possess Buddha-nature from the beginning, why must one engage in rigorous meditative practice?

keyWorks.title: Shōbōgenzō (Treasury of the True Dharma Eye)
keyWorks.description: Masterwork of philosophical Zen analyzing the nature of time, existence (Uji), mountains and waters, and the dropping off of body and mind.

keyWorks.title: Fukanzazengi (Universally Recommended Instructions for Zazen)
keyWorks.description: Seminal instructional manual establishing zazen sitting meditation as the immediate realization of awakening.
